proofs.text: Run with `--gate tested` and verify `.github/workflows/purlin.yml` is absent and the output contains `pass --ci to write it anyway`; run with `--gate tested --ci github` and verify the file is there

rule_text: Under `tested` no CI workflow is written and the summary says `--ci` writes it anyway; `--ci` under `tested` writes it

tests.body:
def test_tested_writes_no_workflow(self, project):
        output = project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        assert not project.has('.github/workflows/purlin.yml')
        assert 'pass --ci to write it anyway' in output
tests.name: test_ci_under_tested_writes_it_anyway
